formation_structure.artillery: Steward covers the eastern flight. Midnight and Lava cover the western return. Their sustained supported damage must be sufficient without assuming target ordering, splash, critical hits or GALLUS resistance reduction.
formation_structure.deployment_limit: Count every deployed operator toward eight. Midnight deploys before Fang retreats; same-tile medical and lower outer replacements retreat their predecessors first.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP; natural +1 DP/s; Fang initial effective cost 10; supported Fang grants only while deployed; Vanilla grants only on successful ready skill activation.
economy.conditions: Checkpoints depend on living Fang through his credited grants, successful Vanilla activations and the stated retreats. Credit only the supplied conditional refunds: Lancet 1, GALLUS 1 and Fang 5. No other refund or unsupported income funds an action.
economy.gallus_boundary: GALLUS has a 200-second redeployment time. A retreat at frame 2700 prevents reentry before frame 8700. Do not credit an early western return; no supplemental GALLUS deployment is required or budgeted.
economy.reentries: Ansel, Hibiscus and Melantha require observed availability, actual deployment price and available DP. An unaffordable handoff is a survival failure; it does not authorize assumed refunds.

formation_structure.execution_gates: Conditions are verification assertions, not invented runtime actions. If a required gate fails, record the broken dependency and invalidate the dependent schedule; do not silently delay actions, invent income or declare success.
formation_structure.inheritance_boundary: The inline prior structure is M43-V1. The complete frozen M43-V2 artifact was not supplied inline and could not be inspected because the read-only shell failed to start. No exact reconstruction of omitted V2 actions or simulated success is claimed.
formation_structure.medical_dependencies: Lower professional healing is absent between frames 2100 and 5460. Beagle and Popukar must actually survive that interval. Upper treatment passes Lancet to Hibiscus, then to returning Ansel; no unsupported healing talent is credited.
formation_structure.opening: Fang owns upper central, Beagle lower central, Vanilla upper outer and Friston lower outer. Lancet treats the upper pair; Ansel begins lower treatment at frame 1200.
formation_structure.protection: Vanilla attacks western upper obstruction; GALLUS and Steward attack eastern upper obstruction; Popukar attacks western lower obstruction; temporary Melantha attacks eastern lower obstruction. Confirm destruction and each civilian's safe arrival separately.

formation_transitions.transition: Start lower Ansel treatment before the saved conditional Friston death window.
Retreat living Friston, then place Popukar on [6,3]. Preserve interception through the replacement.
Withdraw living Ansel from eastern artillery exposure; his departure starts the explicit lower healing hiatus.
Retreat Lancet and deploy Hibiscus on [2,3].
Withdraw GALLUS only after confirmed eastern upper roadblock destruction.
Deploy Midnight behind Fang before withdrawing Fang; released upper central enemies must encounter Midnight.
Withdraw Hibiscus only after first civilian safe arrival and sufficient upper survival margin for Ansel's return.
Withdraw temporary Melantha only after eastern lower obstruction destruction and civilian passage beyond it.
Return Ansel to [2,6] only when available and affordable.
Withdraw Steward only after artillery death or departure from his actual range.
Withdraw Lava only after artillery destruction; otherwise the planned final handoff has failed.
Return Hibiscus to lower treatment and deploy Durin after temporary attackers have vacated their slots.
Return Melantha at [4,4] before late central runner accumulation.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected or deployed operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity from 1 through 3 and qualification.normal_mode true; no mode-specific reserve units.
Every DEPLOY uses an integer [row,col], a supplied deployable tile and UP, DOWN, LEFT or RIGHT. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Never exceed eight deployed operators or overlap an occupied tile. Perform same-tile retreats before replacements.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Roadblocks require actual destruction; officers within 1.2 can threaten civilians. Record two safe arrivals and zero protected-target deaths.
Spend only observed available DP. Failed living retreats, premature deaths, unavailable reentries or missing skill grants invalidate dependent handoffs rather than creating an arithmetic exception.
Maintain all four corridor owners; Midnight must be deployed before Fang retires, and Popukar must replace Friston before a released lower outer enemy can escape.
Do not equate retreat with cancellation of a fixed-point projectile. No target tie-break, exact client timing or unprovided blast geometry is assumed.
Do not rely on splash geometry, probabilistic talents, robot mitigation, GALLUS resistance reduction, unsupported self-healing or invented roadblock navigation.
Activate only while deployed and ready. Time-SP pauses during active skills; repeated activations below require an ongoing battle and actual pressure.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions and both opening medical ranges; preserve Friston until replacement.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A released runner or dead predecessor breaks the opening handoff; subsequent DP cannot reverse a leak.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Destroy both upper obstructions, intercept upper officers and confirm the first safe civilian arrival.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Missing destruction or arrival invalidates the upper evacuation and medical withdrawal schedule.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Destroy both lower obstructions and confirm the second safe civilian arrival without officer contact.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A surviving roadblock or protected-target death rejects project acceptance.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Sustain eastern and western artillery damage and restore upper professional healing.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Caster losses, failed medical reentry or insufficient artillery damage invalidate the final formation handoff.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Restore lower healing and add Durin and Melantha before final central runner and armored pressure.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Failed reentry, unsustainable damage or block overflow invalidates late clearance.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Maintain blocking, healing and ready skills until all hostiles are cleared and both civilians are recorded safe.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A time boundary or exhausted spawn schedule alone does not establish WIN.

skill_intents.intent: Credit automatic six-DP grants near frames 570,1320,2070 and 2820 only if actually observed while Fang remains deployed.

Activate first at frame 1170 and then every 900 frames while deployed and ready: 10 active seconds plus 20 inactive recovery seconds. Each successful activation supplies six DP and the supported ATK increase.
First DEF activation at frame 1740; subsequent cycles are 2100 frames apart. No unsupported DEF talent is credited.
Opening activation at frame 1950. After reentry at 4200, activate at 4950 and then every 1800 frames when pressure warrants. Count supported ATK and forward-range extension only.
Opening activation at frame 3240. After reentry at 5460, activate at 6360 and then every 1500 frames when needed. No unsupported ATK talent is credited.

First readiness is frame 4350. Use the supported arts conversion and ATK increase during western artillery contact; next readiness follows 40 active plus 70 inactive seconds. Retain later arts windows for central armored enemies.
Deployment SP makes the skill ready at frame 3930; hold until frame 4350 for western artillery contact. Credit selected-target damage and supported attack speed, with no splash multiplication.
First ATK readiness is frame 2790; hold until frame 3480 for outer officer pressure, then use legal 1800-frame cycles. Count single-target output.
Use base attacks during temporary roadblock clearance. After reentry at frame 5760, first ATK readiness is 6960; subsequent cycles are 1800 frames apart.
Use ordinary arts attacks and Steward's supported attack-SP enhanced hits. Do not assume highest-defense selection, resistance reduction or favorable target ordering.

tactical_thesis: Retain the supplied four-corridor structure: earlier lower healing must preserve Friston for Popukar's living replacement; separate roadblock attackers must release both civilians; Steward, Midnight and Lava must kill the artillery; professional healing and lower arts damage must then support final clearance. M43-V2 was rejected before simulation, so its schema feedback establishes no new combat failure or improvement. Correct the prediction literal to RETREAT. Every survival, clearance and redeployment gate remains an unverified obligation.
